profile.headline: Hands-on Global Technology Executive | VP of Engineering | IT Leadership | Systems Design | Quantitative Finance
profile.summary:
I love to build solutions.  I am happiest when I'm in a community and steering people, processes and technology to deliver on a shared vision.  I've done this by fostering a collaborative environment that ensures the output of our team is 10X the sum of the output of the individual contributors.  Furthermore, the solution is built to last the test of time and is able to grow with the needs of the business and is delivered in the allocated timeline and budget.

I love to code.  Even before I learned to code, I enjoyed single player puzzles.  Puzzles are a way to focus on a problem, and with enough grit will generate success.  But, completing the puzzles isn't an endpoint.  Often I revisit a completed puzzle to find a more optimal solution.  It can be challenging to include new friends in a puzzle, but when you do you can learn from that friend's knowledge and experience.  To me, building software solutions is like a puzzle.  It requires heavy focus, can always be improved, and it's more fun when executed with a team.

I love data.  Most of my career, data has underpinned our business. Exposing data, metadata and enhancing data to customers unlocks innovation.  This is further enhanced when a culture of data governance is baked into the DNA of the team.


Core Competencies:
IT Leadership -> 
IT Management | Coaching | Communication | Project Management | Collaborative Leadership | Conflict Management | Negotiation | Teamwork 

Information Technology -> 
Systems Design | Technical Architecture | Software Design | Database Architecture/Design | Cloud Infrastructure |Software Design Patterns | Software Development | Agile | SAFe

Investment Banking ->
Fixed Income | Derivatives | Market Data | Market Risk | Quantitative Finance | Trading Systems


For a full version of my resume, please contact me via LinkedIn

positions.title: Director, S&P Dow Jones Indices Technology
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
Performed as a hands-on technical manager. Led a global heterogeneous team of on/off shore employees/consultants, with focus on Development and QE Teams leveraging shared COEs (PMO, DBAs, infrastructure and Operations teams).

Selective Achievements:

•Directed the modernization of the flagship Index Calculation platform resulting in horizontal scalability, alignment with compliance/security standards, and most importantly reduction in the quantity/severity of operational incidence.

•Drove the technology solution for the custom Index revenue line by developing the team, processes and technology to rapidly develop bespoke indices.

•Adopted and implemented a fit-for-purpose cloud strategy providing teams an incremental transition to reduce costs and leveraged rich services such as ECS, Lambda, and s3/RDS/DynamoDb.

positions.title: Analytics Software Engineer
positions.description:
Directed Development and support of an enterprise Fixed Income Analytics System (FIAS) to provide real-time pricing and risk.

Selective Achievements:

•Empowered firm to manage market risk by building a solution for calculating real-time pricing and risk for all the firm’s assets.

•Provided a highly distributed, fault tolerant and scalable system by implementing a Service Oriented Architecture using core Java and Spring.

•Improved performance by designing framework to provide consistent risk and pricing for all assets every 5 seconds, leveraging Gemfire as a distributed cache.

•Increased user-base by supporting asynchronous requests without increasing costs.

positions.title: Fixed Income Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed technology team that supports firmwide fixed income trading operations using Java and related technologies.

Selective Achievements:

•Enhanced employee engagement by conducting individual career development plans in addition to administrating interviews, onboarding, and periodic performance reviews.

•Reduced operational risks by building internal sub systems using Java technologies including Spring, Ant, and JDBC.

•Provided delivery transparency by overseeing the entire Software Development Lifecycle from requirements gathering to testing for large scale projects.

positions.title: Risk Systems Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Fulfilled all technology requests from Risk Managers and Analyst, using .NET 3.5 technologies, including C#, and SQL Server.

Selective Achievements:

•Generated complex user reports using external vendor Web Services.

•Decreased reliance on 3rd party tools by constructing service interfaces using Windows Communication Foundation.

positions.title: Credit Derivatives Team Lead
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Hands-on Java Team Lead directing requirements and resources for Fixed Income Prime Brokerage (FIPB) to utilize franchise Credit Derivatives Trading System.

Selective Achievements:

•Streamlined delivery of FIPB business by managing expectations, prioritizing requests, and gathering requirements.

•Designed fundamental Java Web Service components including Straight Through Processing of Post Trade Events (ie amendments, assignments, and terminations) hosted in Apache Axis. 

•Increased UI clients by redesigning and implementing Java Web Service for Blotters to query trades using a SQL-like message.
